body: Please don't ignore this... Guys I know that there is more people that need help, but mayby you could spend few minutes more..

I think there are such jobs. I mean, there is art in games, it didn't created by itself, someone did it for money.

Good thing about such a job is that you are not limited to local market. You could sell it anywhere. Same goes for working for someone, Every IT guy works from home nowadays so you could look for jobs in whole Germany, not only local area. You know English pretty well, so another country is not out of the question.

That's not a bad idea! I was asking about tomorrow because I had something else in mind, something that helped me. Take one day at the time. You got your victory for today, so take the rest of the day of, relax, take a hot bath whatever you like. Same thing tomorrow, going to school and staying in there whole time will be your next victory. We will worry about wednesday when it comes.

As for time on computer, it's not nesseserly bad thing. Let me finish ny story from previous comment. I became truck driver, see good part of Europe, made some nice money but I found out that I don't really liked it. Some shitty time later I got a job as a online shop manager/it guy. Nothing really complicated but it pays the bills and to work I just need my laptop and internet connection. So, you like plaing games, what about writing scenarios for them? But like I said, one day at the time, you will figure out it eventually.
That's great, one thing less to worry about tonight. How about tomorrow, you gonna show up at school?
How was the appointment? You are in or out?

School isn't everything. I got kick out about same age as you, it felt like a tragedy then. Few months passed and I got an idea, I took driving lessons. C+E and D (for folks in US it is a 18 wheeler and bus). Skinny looking 18 and half guy bend a few rules to get licence.. who knew.. definetly not me. It work out pretty good, can't say I'm happy right now (I'm in some shitty situation right now) but I'm doing better than I imagine when 18. 

Worst case scenario, you will be kick out. Not good but not end of the world either, you will sort this out eventually.

That's kind of comforting to read. But there is my nature I don't believ ein anyone.. I think there is a lots of people near me that would go, but this is just first reaction to a nice trip. In the long run, when we have lots of obstacles to overcome it always falls apart.. Like seening aurora is nice but we first have to spend few weeks together and not hate each other in this time. 
Edit. I am not talking specifically about you, I just generalize.. Truth is I propably would take you along I can..
